title: Protocol for analysis of mouse neutrophil NETosis by flow cytometry
protocol: Prepare all necessary buffers for the experiment.
Soak dissection tools in 70% EtOH to sterilize them.
Using a 20-gauge needle, poke three holes into the bottom of a 0.5mL microcentrifuge tube.
Place this perforated tube into a clean 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube.
Prepare one set of microcentrifuge tubes for each sample.
Label 15mL conical tubes, one for each sample.
Prepare 1.5mL microcentrifuge tubes with 15uL of trypan blue, two for each sample.
Use the Miltenyi negative selection bone marrow neutrophil purification kit for magnetic-based isolation of mouse bone marrow neutrophils.
Collect and isolate mouse bone marrow neutrophils according to the protocol provided.
Aliquot 3 mL of bone collection buffer into one well of a 6-well plate for each sample.
Keep the plate on ice.
Euthanize each mouse according to the procedures approved by your Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
Place the mouse in a prone position after ensuring euthanasia.
Extract the femurs and tibias from the mouse.
Remove all skin, muscle, and tendons using sterile tools and clean paper towels.
Put the cleaned bones into one well of the 6-well plate containing bone collection buffer on ice for each animal.
Cut the epiphyses of the bones with small scissors and place the bones cut side down into the 0.5mL/1.5mL collection tube.
Flush the bone marrow out by centrifuging for 30 s at 10,000g between 20°C-25°C.
Discard the bones and resuspend the collected sample in 1ml of resuspension buffer while minimizing air bubbles.
Carefully transfer the 1ml suspension to a 15mL conical tube.
Lyse red blood cells using 10ml of Red Blood Cell Lysis buffer for 1ml of suspension.
Invert to mix and incubate for 2 min between 20°C-25°C.
Centrifuge at 300×g for 10 min at 4°C.
Prepare a 70 μm filter by rinsing it with 2ml of resuspension buffer.
Remove the supernatant by aspiration and resuspend the pellet in 5ml of resuspension buffer.
Filter a 5mL suspension on 70 μM mesh filters to retain only single cells for downstream processing.
Add an additional 5mL of resuspension buffer onto the filter.
Centrifuge the sample at 300×g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of resuspension buffer.
Take 15 μL of the 1 mL suspension and add this to one of the 15 μL of trypan blue in 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Slowly pipette up and down to mix.
Repeat for each sample.
Take 15 μL from the trypan blue/sample mix and insert this into one of the wells of the COUNTESS chamber slide.
Count the cells and check for viability using the COUNTESS.
Isolate the neutrophils from the suspension using the Miltenyi Biotec Neutrophil Isolation Kit, LS columns, and quadroMACS magnets, following the manufacturer’s directions.
Take 15 μL of isolated neutrophils and add to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube containing 15 μL of trypan blue.
Pipette up and down slowly to mix thoroughly.
Repeat the process for each sample.
Take 15 μL from the trypan blue/sample mixture and place it into one well of the COUNTESS chamber slide.
Assess purified primary neutrophil viability and yield using the automated COUNTESS cell counter.
Prepare three equi-cellular mixes (250,000 cells in each 5 mL polystyrene round-bottom tube) for unstained and single-stained controls to draw gates.
Keep remaining cells on ice.
Pellet cells at 300×g at 4°C for 10 min in a refrigerated centrifuge.
Remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend cells in 50 μL of flow cytometry staining buffer containing mouse Fc receptor blocker.
Block cells by incubating at 4°C for 10 min.
Prepare 50 μL of a 2× antibody solution in flow cytometry staining buffer for each sample.
Add the 50 μL of 2× antibody solution to the 50 μL of blocked cells.
Leave one control sample unstained and perform a single stain for each antibody using two other samples.
Stain the cells by incubating at 4°C for 20 min, protecting from light.
Add 1 mL of resuspension buffer to wash away excess antibody.
Pellet cells by centrifuging at 300×g at 4°C for 10 min.
Repeat washing step with 1 mL of resuspension buffer.
Resuspend cells in 250 μL of resuspension buffer (50,000-100,000 cells per 100 μL).
Run samples on a MACSQuant10 flow cytometer.
Use unstained and single-stained samples to set up appropriate gates that encompass clear positive and negative populations.
Adjust the scatter signals to exclude debris, dead cells, and doublets.
Incubate the samples for 2 hours to induce NETosis.
Resuspend remaining cells in 15 mL conical tubes at a concentration of 2 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Prepare two 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes for each sample, one for DMSO and another for PMA.
Aliquot 500 μL of cells into the 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes (totaling 1 × 10^6 cells).
Dilute SYTOX Green stock solution in neutrophil culture medium at a ratio of 1:250.
Protect diluted SYTOX Green from light.
Add 5 μL of the diluted SYTOX Green to each tube.
Protect from light.
Prepare the DMSO and PMA working stocks.
Supplement neutrophil culture media with DMSO [Vehicle] or 100nM PMA (2× concentration).
Add 500 μL of the DMSO or PMA supplemented media to the respective microcentrifuge tubes (for a final concentration of 50nM PMA).
Slowly invert three times to mix.
Seed 200 μl (2 × 10^5 cells) in technical quadruplicates in wells of a sterile black 96-well suspension plate.
Incubate in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2 at 37°C for 2 h.
Measure the fraction of cells positive for SYTOX Green in each well using the MACSQuant10 flow cytometer.
